item.title: Coldcard firmware flaw lets attackers reconstruct private keys; $89M drained from 4,500 wallets in three waves since July 30.
U.S. Senate has 4 legislative days before August recess to advance CLARITY Act; passage odds fall to 30%, per Galaxy Digital.
BlackRock, Fidelity and other Wall Street firms formally back the CLARITY Act in letters to U.S. Senate leadership.
Tether posts $1.5B Q2 operating profit driven by Treasury holdings; reserve buffer falls by half to $4.1B.
U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs record $265M net outflows on July 31 as stalled crypto legislation weighs on institutional demand.
FATF warns criminal networks are deploying freeze-resistant stablecoins and urges jurisdictions to accelerate AML enforcement.
Morgan Stanley files with the SEC for spot Bitcoin and Solana ETFs, deepening traditional finance exposure to digital assets.
BNY Mellon's Belgian subsidiary registers as a crypto-asset service provider under the EU MiCA framework.
Australia's AML/CTF Travel Rule takes full effect July 1, requiring VASPs to collect and share identity data on all crypto transfers.
SEC and CFTC open joint public consultation on aligning portfolio margin rules across crypto securities and derivatives markets.
Crypto industry records worst quarter with 83 security incidents costing $755M in Q2 2026; bridge exploits are the top attack vector.
JPMorgan launches JPM Coin deposit token on Coinbase's Base network for near-instant institutional payments.
JPMorgan, Bank of America and Citi plan a shared tokenized deposit network for institutional settlement, targeting H1 2027.
